init_swarm_mc_interpreter: initialize a SwarmMCInterpreter with swarm task objects for move, build, destroy, and dig
handle_stop_swarm_workers: stop all swarm workers and pause the task stack in the SwarmMCInterpreter
handle_resume_swarm_workers: resume all swarm workers and restore archived loop data in the SwarmMCInterpreter
override_task_objects: override task objects in SwarmMCInterpreter to use swarm variants of move, build, destroy, and dig
review_swarm_mc_interpreter: review the SwarmMCInterpreter class that extends MCInterpreter with swarm-aware stop and resume handling
